coaching.headline: We won three fights but converted only one, and let three objectives fall uncontested as towers went seven to two.
coaching.team: Three of five lanes read 'theirs all game': carry against Kira, midlane against The Fey, support against Riktor. The jungle matchup against Feng Mao was the one favored read on the sheet. Lt. Belica took first blood on The Fey at 7.2, but the Fangtooth fight at 13.2 was lost 2-3, even though we answered with our own Mini Prime in the same window. From there the towers went one way: the Outer Tower fell at 17.4. The next lost fight cost the Outer and Inner Tower together, at 18.4 and 18.7. A second Inner Tower fell at 23.4. The 26.9 fight at their Outer Tower was fought a body down, four versus five, after Revenant's lone solo death of the match 32 seconds earlier, and it cost us the Primal Fangtooth. We won three fights to their seven and cashed only one of them; the Inhibitor fell at 29.2 with nobody dead at all, and the Core went down 1-4 three minutes later.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 17.7 fight, lost 1-3, cost the Outer and Inner Tower together, even though we answered with Fangtooth at 20. From there we turned only one of three won fights into a prize while they converted six of seven, and the Inhibitor fell uncontested at 29.2 with nobody dead.
coaching.whatWorked: Khaimera's early jungle matchup read favored on the sheet, and Xeebs backed it up, killing Kira three separate times before the 21-minute mark.

focus.title: Two Genesis Cores fell with nobody dead on our side
focus.evidence: Genesis Core fell twice, at 20 and 28, both times with every one of our five players alive -- not a fight loss, a map-presence gap.
focus.action: Assign someone to track and contest Genesis Core the moment it spawns -- a free objective with a full roster alive is the cheapest fix available.

threats: Chain-CC risk (3 hard-CC abilities, ~2.5s of lockdown): Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Alacrity shield+AS → Consecrated Ground bubble → Reversal global save
ourKits.winCondition: keep the carry alive with global shields and enable their damage
ourKits.passive: abilities grant Sentinel to allies; on-hit bonus
ourKits.playAgainst: she has no damage threat — dive her carry through the shields or pick her first

ourKits.combo: Scar mark → Obliterate homing missiles → Reckoning 1v1 realm ult
ourKits.winCondition: Reckoning a target into the Nether Realm and crit them down 1v1
ourKits.playWith: a team to clean up if his 1v1 stalls
ourKits.playAgainst: the ult is a 1v1 — peel the realmed ally can't help, so don't be caught alone; he's crit-reliant early-weak

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

ourKits.combo: Stasis Bomb stun → Photon Disruptor slow → Containment Fence wall → Ion Strike slow ult
ourKits.winCondition: lock a target with stun + fence and let the team collapse
ourKits.passive: Rocket Boots mobility, refreshed by abilities
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her stun/fence into a kill
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Stasis Bomb; the fence zones — flank around it

enemyKits.combo: Mercy poke → stack Vengeance → Shadow Glide reposition → Purge ult
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Vengeance and shred with the channeled Purge
enemyKits.playWith: peel so she can channel Purge safely
enemyKits.playAgainst: interrupt/CC her during Purge; punish her short dash cooldown

enemyKits.combo: Riplash pull → Shock Therapy silence → Skewer suppress ult
enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and chain silence+suppress for a guaranteed kill
enemyKits.playWith: burst that deletes his pulled/suppressed target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect Riplash range — stay spaced; cleanse/QSS the suppress

enemyKits.combo: Reaping Dash → Hamstring slows → Safeguard spellshield → Earth Shatter execute
enemyKits.winCondition: trade with the spellshield up and execute low targets with Earth Shatter
enemyKits.passive: permanent power on unique hero takedowns
enemyKits.playWith: setup that holds a target for the execute
enemyKits.playAgainst: bait Safeguard's spellshield before committing the key CC

enemyKits.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Harvest Nettles stacks → Untamed Growth DoT → Fly Trap pull ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Fly Trap a clumped team and detonate AoE on the pull
enemyKits.passive: takedowns spawn growths + grant move speed
enemyKits.playWith: engage that clumps for her Fly Trap
enemyKits.playAgainst: spread out vs the pull; she's squishy — dive her
